seoDescription: Custom outdoor kitchens for Houston-area homes, planned with your pool and patio. See the layout in 3D and request a free design consultation.

blocks.title: Custom outdoor kitchens
blocks.introduction: Island Life Custom Pools designs and builds outdoor kitchens made for entertaining and relaxing, planned to fit the pool and patio around them, for homes across the Houston area. Cook, gather, and stay in the moment.
blocks.ctaLabel: Start with a free design consult
blocks.imageAlt: Stone outdoor kitchen under a cedar-framed patio cover

blocks.label: Designed for your property
blocks.title: A kitchen planned with the backyard.
blocks.lede: An outdoor kitchen works best as part of the complete backyard, not an afterthought. We design it together with the pool, spa, patio, fire pit, and fireplace, so cooking, dining, and conversation all happen in the same place—and you can explore the layout in a custom 3D model before construction begins.
checklist: A kitchen planned as part of the complete backyard, not added afterward
Counters, a grill, and bar seating arranged for cooking and conversation
Coordinated with the patio cover, fireplace, and pool around it
A custom 3D model to explore the space before construction

blocks.imageAlt: Stone fireplace beside built-in outdoor kitchen cabinets and a firewood niche
blocks.eyebrow: See it before we build it
blocks.title: Cook where you gather.
blocks.text: Your free design consult leads into a custom 3D design, so you can see the kitchen, the seating, and the space around them before construction begins. The goal stays simple: an easy place to cook and plenty of room for everyone to settle in.

blocks.text: We are a thoroughly vetted and endorsed enterprise backed by Google. The Google Guaranteed badge is an exclusive endorsement that not all companies can secure. Having undergone a comprehensive evaluation by Google, we have earned their esteemed badge, signifying our reliability and authenticity as a business.

questions.question: What can an outdoor kitchen include?
questions.answer: Counters, a grill, storage, and bar seating arranged for cooking and conversation, plus a fireplace or fire pit, a patio cover, and the pool around it, depending on your design.

questions.question: Can the kitchen be planned with my pool and patio?
questions.answer: Yes. We design the kitchen together with the pool, spa, patio, fire pit, and fireplace, so cooking, dining, and conversation all happen in the same place.

questions.question: Do you build the patio cover too?
questions.answer: Yes. We design and build custom patios and patio covers, so the shade and the kitchen are planned as one space.

questions.question: Can you add an outdoor kitchen to a patio I already have?
questions.answer: Yes. Tell us about your patio during the free design consultation, and we will plan the kitchen to fit the space, with a cover, a fireplace, or seating if you want them.

questions.question: How much does an outdoor kitchen cost?
questions.answer: The cost depends on the size and layout, the counters and finishes you choose, and whether it sits under a cover. After your free design consultation we provide a quote for your project.

questions.question: Can I see the layout before construction starts?
questions.answer: Yes. We create a 3D model of your outdoor space, so you can see the kitchen, the seating, and the space around them before construction begins.
